content: CVE Details | ID: CVE-2026-1002 | Severity: HIGH | Component: Web Interface | Description: Dahua DVRs and NVRs manufactured before Oct 2025 contain a default backdoor password for the 'admin' account when accessed via specific legacy mobile apps. This allows full remote administrative access. | Remediation: Update to the latest firmware and perform a factory reset to invalidate the legacy credentials. Ensure multi-factor authentication is enabled if supported.

raw.description: Dahua DVRs and NVRs manufactured before Oct 2025 contain a default backdoor password for the 'admin' account when accessed via specific legacy mobile apps. This allows full remote administrative access.
raw.remediation: Update to the latest firmware and perform a factory reset to invalidate the legacy credentials. Ensure multi-factor authentication is enabled if supported.

content: CVE Details | ID: CVE-2026-1003 | Severity: HIGH | Component: SOAP API | Description: Axis Communication IP cameras have a buffer overflow in the SOAP API handler. Sending an oversized XML payload can lead to memory corruption and potential Remote Code Execution (RCE). | Remediation: Apply security patch AX-2026-1. Axis recommends disabling ONVIF/SOAP services if they are not actively being used for integration.

raw.description: Axis Communication IP cameras have a buffer overflow in the SOAP API handler. Sending an oversized XML payload can lead to memory corruption and potential Remote Code Execution (RCE).
raw.remediation: Apply security patch AX-2026-1. Axis recommends disabling ONVIF/SOAP services if they are not actively being used for integration.

content: CVE Details | ID: CVE-2026-1004 | Severity: MEDIUM | Component: Cloud Portal | Description: TP-Link Tapo C200 monitoring application has a path traversal vulnerability in the local recording playback module. An attacker on the same network can access sensitive system logs and configuration files. | Remediation: Update the Tapo mobile application to version 2.11 or higher. Ensure the camera is on an isolated VLAN from untrusted devices.

raw.description: TP-Link Tapo C200 monitoring application has a path traversal vulnerability in the local recording playback module. An attacker on the same network can access sensitive system logs and configuration files.
raw.remediation: Update the Tapo mobile application to version 2.11 or higher. Ensure the camera is on an isolated VLAN from untrusted devices.

content: CVE Details | ID: CVE-2026-1005 | Severity: CRITICAL | Component: System Shell | Description: Wyze Cam v3 firmware contains hardcoded SSH RSA private keys that are shared across all devices in a specific production batch. Allows root access if the SSH service is enabled. | Remediation: Disable SSH via the app settings. Wyze has released a critical update v3.10.5 that rotates these keys and disables SSH by default.

raw.remediation: Disable SSH via the app settings. Wyze has released a critical update v3.10.5 that rotates these keys and disables SSH by default.

content: CVE Details | ID: CVE-2026-1006 | Severity: CRITICAL | Component: HTTP Server | Description: Reolink NVR web server is vulnerable to a stack-based buffer overflow when parsing the 'User-Agent' header. This can be exploited for RCE with root privileges. | Remediation: Install the March 2026 security patch (REO-MAR-2026). As a workaround, put the NVR behind a reverse proxy that sanitizes HTTP headers.

raw.description: Reolink NVR web server is vulnerable to a stack-based buffer overflow when parsing the 'User-Agent' header. This can be exploited for RCE with root privileges.
raw.remediation: Install the March 2026 security patch (REO-MAR-2026). As a workaround, put the NVR behind a reverse proxy that sanitizes HTTP headers.

content: CVE Details | ID: CVE-2026-1007 | Severity: MEDIUM | Component: API Endpoint | Description: Lorex Cloud API fails to properly validate the 'session_id' for cross-account requests. An attacker can view camera feeds of other users by incrementing the camera ID in API requests. | Remediation: Lorex has updated their cloud infrastructure to fix this server-side. No user action required, but rotating API keys is recommended as a precaution.

raw.description: Lorex Cloud API fails to properly validate the 'session_id' for cross-account requests. An attacker can view camera feeds of other users by incrementing the camera ID in API requests.
raw.remediation: Lorex has updated their cloud infrastructure to fix this server-side. No user action required, but rotating API keys is recommended as a precaution.

content: CVE Details | ID: CVE-2026-1008 | Severity: LOW | Component: ONVIF Service | Description: Amcrest cameras are susceptible to a Denial of Service (DoS) attack. Restrict local network access to trusted devices only.

content: CVE Details | ID: CVE-2026-1009 | Severity: LOW | Component: Storage | Description: Arlo Pro 4 cameras store local diagnostic logs in cleartext on the SD card, including Wi-Fi credentials and motion trigger timestamps. If the SD card is stolen, this data is exposed. | Remediation: Enable log encryption in the Arlo Secure app settings. Arlo recommends using the cloud-only logging mode for maximum security in high-risk locations.

raw.remediation: Enable log encryption in the Arlo Secure app settings. Arlo recommends using the cloud-only logging mode for maximum security in high-risk locations.
